default_decision.rule: frozen development protocol; no test-set tuning

limitations: 12 queries from 4 new development campaign clusters; within-event queries are correlated.
No held-out test set; defaults chosen only under the preregistered development rule.
English queries and English MiniLM models; Chinese and other languages not evaluated.
Grade 3 means direct answer field; grade 1 means background/supporting same-event field. Other evidence groups are grade 0 for these narrow questions.
Labels may require independent review before formal evaluation; no general investigation-accuracy claim.
